name: Gradient Launch
tagline: Scattered letters hop into place on a near-black stage; light, gradient and product UI ignite on the beat.
description: A dark product-launch language: white lower-case geometric sans words assemble from letters scattered across the frame that hop into their slots on a shared tick grid (held frames, no tween), small pink squares hopping with them. Between the words, one warm gradient light (orange → pink → violet) does everything: a letter stretches into a light streak and flares inside a glass tile, the tile becomes a glowing input pill whose border carries a running light, the send button fires gradient rings, a dashed outline word fills and finally ignites in gradient while a dark giant echo slides past behind it. Cut to the bar, fast, clean, premium.
bestFor: app feature reels and changelog films
social promos cut to a beat
dark-mode SaaS with a gradient brand
avoidFor: long VO-led explainers with dense copy

hop.note: letters and squares move on a shared tick grid: hold 1–5 frames, jump with no interpolation, land on the slot

signature: hop assemble: scattered letters hop on a shared tick grid into the word, pink squares hop with them and stand in for missing letters
letter to light: one letter of a gradient word stretches into a streak that flares white-hot inside a glass tile
send pulse: the gradient send button is pressed and two gradient rings expand from it across the frame
ignition: a white word jumps in scale and fills with a flowing gradient while a giant dark echo of it slides past behind
avoid: light backgrounds for more than a flash
flat cheap CSS gradients as backgrounds

camera: Mostly locked and centred. Pushes are fast and purposeful: a zoom into the input pill, a camera that tracks the typing caret, an expo-out contraction of a giant word to its resting size. No floating, no handheld.

texture.notes: Clean digital black with a faint violet cast. Light is the only texture: soft gradient glows, a blurred halo around the flare, faint grain inside the round feature icons. No paper, no scanlines.

lighting: One warm gradient light source (orange → pink → violet) that lives in the content: the flare in the glass tile, the light running along the pill border, the rings, the ignited word. Everything else stays near-black.
sound: A bright, punchy electronic track around 120–125 BPM; every word lands on a beat, ticks for the letter hops, a filtered whoosh into the flare, a soft click and a shimmering swell on the send pulse, a sub hit on the ignition.

motionSummary: Moves like a launch film cut to the bar: letters hop into words on a stepped tick grid, then one gradient light carries everything — a streak, a flare in glass, a glowing input pill, rings from the send button and a word that ignites while its dark echo slides past.

composition: one short lower-case word dead centre on near-black, 10–16 % of the frame height, nothing else but a few hopping squares
one giant word in gradient filling half the frame, cropped by the edge
one product object centred: a phone screen, an input pill, a row of round feature icons, a stack of list cards
visual.shapeLanguage: rounded and soft: pills, capsules, circles, glass tiles with a 22 % radius, small rounded squares; thin dashed outlines and dot rings for construction moments
visual.contrast: maximum: white type and one saturated gradient on almost-black; colour appears only where the light is

grammar.pacing: fast and bar-locked: a new word or object every 0.8–1.5 s, short 6–15 f holds where a word reads
grammar.rhythm: stepped and beat-cut: letters and squares hop on a tick grid (no tween), words land on beats, scenes hard-cut on the bar; UI and light moves in between are smooth
grammar.easing: two clocks: hops are held frames with instant jumps; everything else is expo-out on entry ([0.16,1,0.3,1]), ease-in on exit, in-out for camera tracking; never linear
grammar.acceleration: big early deltas that decay (flare contraction, giant-word contraction, dot rings closing), rings that expand nearly constantly and slow a little, exits that accelerate into the cut
movement: hop assemble / hop out of letters
per-letter gradient word with tracking collapse
letter stretches into a tilting light streak
flare halo contracting inside a glass tile
input pill with a running gradient light and blooming typed characters
send button press and two gradient rings
round gradient icons sliding out from behind each other with confetti
dashed outline word contracting and filling
dot rings closing in and counter-rotating
ignition with a dark echo sliding behind
grammar.density: sparse: one word or one object at a time, a handful of squares or confetti dots as punctuation
grammar.holds: short, 6–15 f on each readable word; the hero word may hold 20–30 f while its gradient keeps flowing

transitionPresets.name: Hop assemble
transitionPresets.build: each glyph appears far from its slot (spread 40 % × 42 % of the frame) and jumps — no interpolation — on a shared tick grid (ticks 1–5 f apart), each hop shrinking its offset by ~55 % until it lands; letters land in 3–4 groups over 10–15 f; 3–7 small pink squares hop on the same ticks; reversed, the word hops apart
transitionPresets.sound: a tick per hop group, the landing on a beat

transitionPresets.name: Letter to light
transitionPresets.bridge: one letter (an l, i or stroke)
transitionPresets.build: the other letters hop out and vanish, the chosen stroke slides to centre, stretches (×5) and tilts 40° into a thin gradient streak; on the beat it flashes into a white-hot elongated core with a warm halo that contracts expo-out, then a frosted glass tile fades in around it with a light shaft and floor reflection
transitionPresets.sound: a rising filtered whoosh into a bright flare hit

transitionPresets.name: Tile to pill
transitionPresets.bridge: the glass container and its light
transitionPresets.build: the glass tile widens into an input pill (height ×0.35, radius to full) while its glass border turns into a gradient border with a light running along it; the flare core shrinks into the round gradient send button at the pill's right end; typing starts, each new character blooms violet → pink → white
transitionPresets.sound: a soft glassy swell, key ticks for the typing

transitionPresets.name: Send pulse
transitionPresets.build: the button presses (0.93 → 1.03 → 1), the pill collapses into it and the button glides to centre; two gradient rings (orange → pink → violet → blue) launch 5 f apart and expand from 0.1 to 1.2 frame heights, decelerating, then fade; the button becomes the next object (a result card, a word, an icon)
transitionPresets.sound: a click, then a shimmering swell that follows the rings

transitionPresets.name: Outline fill
transitionPresets.build: the next word arrives as a dashed outline (marching dashes, muted) at ×2.4, blurred, contracting expo-out to ×1 in 12–16 f; a grey fill band sweeps left → right through it, then it snaps solid white in 2–3 f
transitionPresets.sound: a reversed swell that lands on a snap

transitionPresets.name: Dot rings
transitionPresets.bridge: the space around a centred word
transitionPresets.build: 4–5 concentric rings of small gradient dots (warm and cool) close in from ×2.1 to ×1 expo-out around the word, alternate rings counter-rotating; on exit they open out again with an ease-in and fade

transitionPresets.name: Ignition
transitionPresets.build: a giant dark echo of the word (0.9 frame heights, night colour, faint outline) slides past behind in two or three short passes; on the beat the white word jumps ×1.5–2.7 in 2 f and fills with a vertical violet → pink → orange gradient that keeps flowing, with confetti dots bursting outward
transitionPresets.sound: a sub hit with a bright sparkle tail

transitionPresets.name: Bar cut
transitionPresets.build: hard cut on the bar from one centred word to the next, the new word entering with a 3 f tracking collapse (0.38 em → −0.02 em) and 50 % → 100 % opacity; squares keep hopping across the cut

archetypes.name: Hop word
archetypes.purpose: the line of copy, one short phrase at a time
archetypes.composition: a white lower-case word or two centred on near-black, ~11 % of frame height; small pink squares scattered around
archetypes.elements: letters scattered over the whole frame, 3–7 hopping squares, an optional pink period that lands last
archetypes.motion: letters hop on a tick grid into their slots; squares hop and stand in for missing letters; holds 6–15 f

archetypes.name: Light tile
archetypes.purpose: the spark: an idea, a feature being born, the brand light
archetypes.composition: a white-hot elongated flare tilted ~45° in a warm halo, framed by a frosted glass tile with a light shaft above and a thin reflection below
archetypes.elements: flare core + halo, glass tile (radius 22 %), shaft, floor glint, a few dust motes
archetypes.motion: halo contracts expo-out from the flash, tile fades in around it, the core slowly narrows

archetypes.name: Product UI
archetypes.purpose: the product doing the thing: prompt, result, list
archetypes.composition: a dark phone screen centred, or one element of it (the input pill, a result card, a list) filling the frame
archetypes.elements: the app's real UI; input pill with gradient border and send button, typed prompt, result card, list cards
archetypes.motion: phone rises from blur; the camera pushes into the pill and tracks the caret; new characters bloom; press → rings → result card
archetypes.camera: push-in on the active element, tracking with the caret, pull back on send

archetypes.name: Feature icons
archetypes.purpose: what it can do: three to five capabilities
archetypes.composition: round gradient icons (grainy spheres) in a row at mid-height with labels below; confetti dots around
archetypes.elements: one sphere per feature in palette gradients, a white glyph on each, a typed label, confetti
archetypes.motion: the first sphere pops in centre, the others slide out from behind it; labels type on; confetti pops and drifts outward; exits by shrinking ×0.72 and brightening

archetypes.name: Hero ignition
archetypes.composition: one word centred: first as a dashed outline or inside dot rings, then large in a flowing gradient; a giant dark echo of it passing behind
archetypes.elements: outline word, dot rings or a dashed construction circle, the gradient word, confetti, the dark echo
archetypes.motion: outline contracts and fills, dot rings close in, then the ignition jump and the echo passes; gradient keeps flowing in the hold
archetypes.camera: locked; the scale jump is the impact

beats.purpose: the hook in a few words
beats.motion: letters hop into the first line, squares hop with them
a gradient word's letter becomes light and flares in glass
prompt typed in the glowing pill, send pulse, result, features
outline word fills inside dot rings, then ignites

sequence.cutRhythm: hard cuts on the bar between words, continuous object morphs inside each light/UI passage; a beat every 0.5 s carries hops and landings; 1–3 hard cuts per 4 s

scenes.action: 'every song starts' hops together from letters scattered across the frame; four squares hop with them; it lands on the first downbeat
'small' in a violet → orange gradient; s, m, a hop out, the first l stretches into a streak that flares inside a glass tile
the tile widens into the app's prompt pill; 'warm piano for late nights' types in with blooming letters as the camera tracks the caret; send → two rings → the button stretches into the result card
the card's icon pops in as a sphere; two more slide out from behind it: 'Melody', 'Voice', 'Mix'; confetti drifts outward
'yours' arrives as a dashed outline inside closing dot rings, fills white, then ignites in gradient as its dark echo slides past
the product name in a thin gradient dims as its mark draws itself in a glowing stroke and turns white

elements.text: lower-case geometric sans, semibold, tight tracking, centred, two to four words at a time; assembles by hopping letters, or by a tracking collapse on a cut; giant gradient fragments may fill half the frame for one beat
elements.logo: drawn last as a glowing gradient stroke that turns solid white; the name before it in a thin weight with a gradient
elements.icons: round grainy gradient spheres with a white line glyph, sliding out from behind each other
elements.images: rare and quick: flicker in 4 f each, or duotoned in the brand gradient before switching to colour
elements.ui: the real app in dark mode: phone screen, input pill with gradient border and running light, send button with rings, result card, list cards; typed characters bloom
elements.shapes: small pink rounded squares and dots that hop; dashed outlines and dashed construction circles; rings of gradient dots
elements.background: near-black with a violet cast; a white page only as a short flash or a wipe
elements.particles: confetti dots in palette colours that pop and drift outward; dust motes in the flare light

audio.sync: every word lands on a beat, hop ticks follow the hi-hats, the flare and the ignition sit on bass hits, the send rings on a downbeat; cuts on the bar
audio.sfx: tiny ticks for hops, a filtered whoosh into the flare, glassy key ticks for typing, a soft click and shimmer for the send pulse, a sub hit with sparkle for the ignition
